verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
For the love poured out
For the price of freedom

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Let the whole earth sing
Hear the praises rising

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
We stand in awe
Of what you've done for us
At the cross

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
The hope of the world
Lifted on high
Calling us home with arms out wide

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
To know you foever
to love you forever
you are our everything

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
You made a way
You are our ransom

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
We owe this life
For all you've done for us
At the cross
